notes.title: About This Game
notes.content:
Demo 1
First demo version is intented to be a tech-demo about visual style and graphics and less about content.
Features:

 graphics and visual style
 combat gameplay example
 only ~5 minutes of content and ~3 of the is gameplay


Demo 2
Second version will have close to final product gameplay with more content. Will be released in first part of 2021.

 full-length game level
 final version of combat gameplay
 other gameplay aspects: inventory, npcs, supernatural gameplay


Release
Will come shortly after second demo.
